style_concept: The Warm Terminal - A developer-friendly homelab dashboard that blends technical precision (monospace data, high-density grids) with warm, human earth tones. Avoids cold blue-grays in favor of deep olive-charcoal and terracotta.

data_and_mono.usage: CRITICAL: Use for all numeric data, prices, dates, geocodes, and tags.

layouts.dashboard_grid: Base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, gap-6. Summary widgets span 1 col, main lists/charts span 2 or 3 cols.
layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-6 or p-8) inside cards. Avoid cramped data. Use space to create hierarchy.

grids: The High Density Grid for Dashboards: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4, Tight gap (gap-4 or gap-6). Summary cards: col-span-1. Main charts/tables: col-span-2 or col-span-3.

components.cards: Flat design (no drop shadow). Background: surface_1. Border: 1px solid border. Slight border color change on hover. Border radius: rounded-xl.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary: bg-accent_primary text-[#111210] hover:brightness-110. Secondary: border border-border text-text_primary hover:bg-surface_2.
components.tables_lists: Dense rows. Use JetBrains Mono for prices/dates. Align numbers to the right. Use subtle border-b for separators.
components.badges_tags: Small pill shapes, using text-xs JetBrains Mono. Use accent_tertiary for 'Active', accent_secondary for 'Upcoming', danger for 'Expired'.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly for sticky headers or modals: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#111210]/70 border-b border-border.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton for a technical look. Dashboard cards use flat backgrounds with 1px borders, no shadows.
visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise/grain texture overlaid on the background for a more organic feel.

motion.micro_interactions: Buttons translate-y-[-1px] on hover. List items transition background color and border smoothly.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in on load using framer-motion.
motion.charts: Charts animate in smoothly on mount.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text_primary and text_secondary meet WCAG AA over surface_1. text-secondary should not be too dim.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

media: Use lucide-react for system icons. For streaming platforms, prioritize standard text or simple brand colors on badges if actual logos are unavailable. Avoid placeholder images.

3d_libraries.usage: Not strictly necessary for this homelab utility, but a subtle Recharts line chart or Visx visualization is recommended for the monthly spend summary to add a data-rich feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use Inter or purple gradients under any circumstance.
Apply 'The Warm Terminal' aesthetic: dark olive/charcoal base with terracotta accents. Avoid cold blues.
Dashboard layout: High density grid, flat cards with 1px borders, no shadows.
Use JetBrains Mono for all dates, prices, and geocode data. Use Outfit for headings.
Use standard JWT login flow on a split screen: one side form, one side a subtle abstract data visualization or pattern.
Pre-seed standard subscriptions with realistic mock data (Netflix, Disney+, Hulu, Max, Prime Video, Spotify) if no backend data is present.
All interactive elements must include a data-testid attribute.
Ensure the sidebar or top nav is sticky and uses a distinct surface color or subtle glassmorphism.
For the profile users list per subscription, display small avatar circles (using provided images or colored initials).
Monthly spend summary should include a clean chart (Recharts) using the accent colors.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
